caption: Boston led by as many as 22, but Detroit came back to win 121-113. Boston led by 13 at halftime. No stretch counted as garbage time. Jayson Tatum played the most minutes, 38.0.
New York led by as many as 10, but Philadelphia came back to win 106-100. New York led by 4 at halftime. No stretch counted as garbage time. Tyrese Maxey played the most minutes, 40.0.
Oklahoma City beat San Antonio 116-104, and its biggest lead was 27. Oklahoma City led by 22 at halftime. No stretch counted as garbage time. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander played the most minutes, 36.0.
